SANAT UPADHYAY

Pursue senior-level roles in Banking operations & Transformation emphasizing expertise in capital markets operations and risk management and Automation with functional knowledge and understanding of Automation Tech stack in Data and process automation.

PROFILE SUMMARY

▶ Offering expertise of over 2 decades with consistent track record of progression, repeatedly achieving goals and producing immediate improvements in the capital markets, focusing on risk management and project oversight, particularly within OTC derivatives and back office operations across a variety of financial institutions.

▶ Led end-to-end operations in OTC derivative middle and back-office functions, ensuring accuracy, regulatory compliance, automation and operational excellence across complex financial instruments.

▶ Directed large-scale projects and transformation initiatives, streamlining workflows, implementing best practices, and enhancing process efficiency while reducing operational risk.

▶ Updated expertise with the latest AI trends in Capital Markets, earning a

certification from the Technical University of Munich.

▶ Managed end-to-end processes across both Listed and OTC markets,

ensuring operational efficiency, accuracy, and regulatory compliance.

▶ Oversaw deliveries across multiple capital market domains, including settlement, OTC lifecycle management, reconciliation, asset servicing, risk, and compliance, driving process standardization and operational excellence. ▶ Established and governed risk management control testing, identifying to safeguard

potential exposures and executing control strategies organizational and client interests.

▶ Excellence in managing end-to-end delivery / program / project planning & implementation from scope management, to activity sequencing, effort & cost estimation, pre-sales activities, risk analysis to quality management in line with the guidelines & norms.

▶ Key People Leader, who has successfully led and motivated team large teams (~250 FTEs) towards growth and success in the organization; extensively coordinated with multi-cultural & global teams for smooth functions.

▶ Big Data and Machine Learning enthusiast

Growth Path: Senior BA and Domain SME for AI Platform Solutions (OTC Confirmation and Syndicated Loans) Roles : Business Analysis , Domain Guidance , BRD , MVP ▶ Working as a Senior Business Analyst and domain expert bringing core business domain guidance , client perspective and business outcome requirements to in house AI product Team working on solution for Structured Paper Confirmations and Syndicated Loans

▶ Created business Rules and Requirement documents assisting to generate accurate prompt generation and receiving

required outcome from 300 Pages + syndicated loans documentation

▶ Working on project to create data model for structured equity, Commodities, IRS and FX confirmations which will be

an input to AI based confirmation solution.

▶ Helped in creating MVP requirements. with Pre and Post process Model using Agentic based solution. The BRD

contained Scenario diagrams for 3 high volume settlement scenarios for Equity NON OTC Settlement

Jun’22- Mar 26 :- eClerx Services Ltd. Growth Path: Delivery Head : APAC and NA Asset Services (Jun’22-Jun’23) Risk and CTB Manager (Jun’23-Sep’24) Head of Drafting and Structured Trade Review (Sep’24-March 26) Roles: Delivery Manager , Transformation Manager ▶ Heading Rates Drafting and Review function for Structured OTC and Notes products, ensuring precise legal

and economic representation across all deal parameters are properly booked in risk systems.

▶ Ensuring drafted structured confirmations incorporate required legal language and accurately reflect the

deal’s economic intent throughout its lifecycle and associated optionality.

▶ Overseeing review of executed confirmations across Interest Rates, Commodities, and FX products to verify

consistency between system bookings and key economic and non-economic parameters.

▶ Managing an extensive portfolio of ~150 structures per product type, maintaining accuracy and adherence to

regulatory and contractual standards with team.

▶ Tracking and resolving deviations through proactive coordination with drafting and booking teams to uphold data

integrity and compliance.

▶ Conducting targeted risk assessments in areas with recurring delivery issues and operational errors, providing

actionable recommendations to client stakeholders for process and platform improvement.

▶ Collaborating with the line manager to drive implementation of these initiatives and continuously tracking

progress to ensure sustainable outcomes.

▶ Leading comprehensive process reviews in program to identify automation opportunities using tools such as Alteryx, VBA (Access), UI Path , Power BI solutions, driving efficiency and accuracy across business operations. ▶ Acting as a Business Analyst for identified automation initiatives, overseeing governance for broader technical

solutions deployed across the program to ensure alignment with strategic and compliance objectives.

▶ Designing and developing tailored training programs for complex processes, including Structured Rates, Equity,

and Credit instrument processing, ensuring consistent capability uplift across teams.

▶ Managing APAC and NA Asset Services (130 FTES) for one of US Investment banking client with consistent green

feedback.

▶ Working with the team on reducing outstanding sticky breaks and claims with focus on root cause analysis and

path to resolution.

Feb’14-Jun’22: State Street Syntel Services P Ltd. as Senior Manager – Settlement Operations Roles: Delivery Management , Risk Management ▶ Guided the project team, assigning tasks to team members and ensured completion of work as per set standards; defined business strategies and organizational policies to enable the strategic coordination of multiple major projects and initiatives to improve efficiency and effectiveness of projects.

▶ Served as Delivery Head for Trade and Transaction Management teams, overseeing a workforce of approximately

150 FTEs across the APAC region (9 clients) and EMEA region (12 clients).

▶ Maintained stringent follow-up on unmatched trades to guarantee timely matching and settlement with

counterparties ahead of custody deadlines, effectively preventing trade fails.

▶ Directed proactive management of failed trades and high-value breaks, driving swift resolution to meet settlement timelines and mitigate financial exposure. Upheld strict procedural compliance and documentation standards to ensure transparency and prevent adverse audit findings.

▶ Established robust governance for reconciliation between IBOR and custody systems, implementing a defined

escalation framework and counterparty contact protocol to ensure efficient issue resolution.

▶ Monitored adherence to KPIs and SLAs through effective resource management, targeted training, and continuous

process enhancements.

▶ Maintained operational risk within defined tolerance levels by reinforcing strong control frameworks and ensuring

full compliance with Risk SOPs.

▶ Led end-client and onshore escalation management, ensuring all concerns were promptly addressed through

effective operational interventions and process adjustments.

▶ Oversaw accurate setup of dividend and fixed-income events in the Risk system by validating event details against

external data sources such as IDS and Bloomberg, maintaining data integrity across platforms.

▶ Ensured all event modifications between ex-date and payment date, particularly rate changes, were

accurately reflected in the Risk system to prevent discrepancies.

▶ Managed reconciliation breaks and claims to maintain continuous alignment between IBOR and custody records,

ensuring financial accuracy and operational transparency.

▶ Executed timely adjustments in IBOR to align with custody tax rates whenever discrepancies were identified,

safeguarding compliance and data consistency.

Head of Operational Risk and Compliance – Middle Office operations ▶ Managed Control Testing for Middle Office operations covering 1000+ FTE with team of 5 Risk Managers. ▶ Risk Culture: Promoting an effective risk awareness culture across operation verticals ▶ Risk Mitigation: Recommend and ensure compliance to controls to mitigate risk in adherence to Risk Framework

by regular risk assessment , risk reporting and adequate escalation procedures.

Market Platforms : ▶ ▶ DTCC Warhouse solution: Design & deployment of productized matching, reconciliation and break resolution

Joined as Analyst (Entry Level) and grew up the ranks to Senior Process Manager

platform for the “DTCC WH”. 9 of the FED 14 Banks on boarded.

▶ Created Portofio Reconciliation logics to mimic DTCC matching logic for Credit, Interest rate and Equity derivatives. ▶ The core logic was considered a golden copy and was replicated in all further reconciliation offerings at eClerx. ▶ Managed team of 25 team members to ensure quality product delivery and customer experience. ▶ Trade Terminations: Productized platform for trade matching and MTM neutral Termination service, Contributed in

design, GUI/workflow aspects and in UAT testing and production deployment.

▶ Confirmation Review Processes : Designed , Deployed and Transitioned Manual Confirmation Review processes for

Credit , interest rate products including structured trades

Operations Consulting: ▶ Advised a large US bank on adding operational capabilities in portfolio matching and break investigation research in London. Enabled transition from a spreadsheet based operating model to controlled & automated (ASP/SQL) model.

▶ Consulted an International Bank with operational improvements in Toronto as a Senior BA. This Corporate Actions process entailed identifying optimization opportunities and minimize process risk with process reengineering

Reference Data ▶ Private Banking, Wealth Management Data Migration and Reporting (2009) : - Designed and Managed Data

Migration and Client Reporting Project for premier UK Investment Bank.

▶ Global Security Data Migration Project: The role involved project and operations Management to migrate legacy

KYC

sections.text:
PROFILE SUMMARY
▶ Offering expertise of over 2 decades with consistent track record of progression, repeatedly achieving goals and producing immediate improvements in the capital markets, focusing on risk management and project oversight, particularly within OTC derivatives and back office operations across a variety of financial institutions.
▶ Led end-to-end operations in OTC derivative middle and back-office functions, ensuring accuracy, regulatory compliance, automation and operational excellence across complex financial instruments.
▶ Directed large-scale projects and transformation initiatives, streamlining workflows, implementing best practices, and enhancing process efficiency while reducing operational risk.
▶ Updated expertise with the latest AI trends in Capital Markets, earning a
certification from the Technical University of Munich.
▶ Managed end-to-end processes across both Listed and OTC markets,
ensuring operational efficiency, accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
▶ Oversaw deliveries across multiple capital market domains, including settlement, OTC lifecycle management, reconciliation, asset servicing, risk, and compliance, driving process standardization and operational excellence. ▶ Established and governed risk management control testing, identifying to safeguard
potential exposures and executing control strategies organizational and client interests.
▶ Excellence in managing end-to-end delivery / program / project planning & implementation from scope management, to activity sequencing, effort & cost estimation, pre-sales activities, risk analysis to quality management in line with the guidelines & norms.
▶ Key People Leader, who has successfully led and motivated team large teams (~250 FTEs) towards growth and success in the organization; extensively coordinated with multi-cultural & global teams for smooth functions.
▶ Big Data and Machine Learning enthusiast
